Both registered tests are rendered as p 0.0000 (the recomputed two-proportion p is about 3e-157). A reader can take that as an exact zero; showing it as below 0.0001 would read correctly.
The estimate caveat 'one quarter of orders in this channel' can be read as 25 per cent of the channel's orders rather than the orders of one calendar quarter.

The Welch t (42.70) and Cohen's d (0.4869) for H-CHANNEL-AOV could only be approximated here (t about 42.6, d about 0.485), using standard errors back-derived from the two-decimal CI bounds, because no cleaned table is in this stage's inputs. They agree to within that rounding and were not confirmed
